correctness.rationale: A surjective compact torus endomorphism makes difference and sum independent Haar variables. Exactly integrating disk-quadrant overlap establishes all branches of the CDF. A direct derivative computation at fixed area gives the all-radius strict order; the four-corner expansion gives a second-order torus tail, squared to fourth order on the quotient. A package-contained checker samples actual quotient distances and numerically corroborates both the CDF and far tail; computations are not used as proof.

value.rationale: The fixed-area rectangular pillowcase is a natural 2-parameter moduli family of flat cone metrics with four angle-π singularities. The result proves a complete rather than small-radius pair-distance distribution; it uniquely identifies a globally stochastically optimal isometry class at all thresholds and calculates a sharp quartic near-diameter law. These facts enable comparisons of every increasing distance loss and upper-tail quantiles and are not isolated numeric invariants or a mere re-expression of known local cone coefficients.
